materials.reviewed_claim: The GPT-5.6 launch publication states Terra pricing of USD 2.50 input and USD 15 output per 1 million tokens.
The July 30 price-performance publication states Terra pricing of USD 2 input and USD 12 output per 1 million tokens starting July 30, and describes Terra as 20% less expensive.

limitations: These are reviewed recorded materials for deterministic replay, not proof of a current network response or current pricing.
The publication dates are normalized day-level semantic coordinates because the pages disclose dates but not exact publication instants.
The root Domain Pack does not construct runtime activation-bound RecordedSourceMaterial identities or grant source access.
The separately packaged public-product adapter requires exact application/json and does not capture or extract these official HTML pages without a future reviewed transport/extraction contract.
